body:
Adds `research/robust-outer`: Byzantine-robust outer aggregation in DiLoCo-style local SGD.

- Any translation-equivariant aggregator makes the outer loop exactly linear: floor = variance term + bias term, stability limit unchanged.
- Median costs pi/2 in variance with no attackers (exact finite-N values); worst-case attack bias is bounded, beats the mean past ~1.4 noise-sigmas of offset.
- More workers don't remove the bias; a longer inner loop H does. Trimming exactly f is worse than the median.
- Matched to literal simulation within 1.3%. 11 tests pass; README bullet and site/projects.json updated; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
